issues.on_page: Street Fund Local Receipts: Other 72,387.62 (p1); Equipment loan issued 1/25/2024, 61,723.82 outstanding at 9/30/24 (p5); Street Fund Other Capital Outlay 70,777.47 and Debt Service 8,276.18 (p3)
issues.issue: A loan was taken out during the year (61,723.82 still owed after 8,276.18 of debt service, i.e. about 70,000 borrowed), but no debt proceeds line is printed. The Street Fund's unexplained 'Other' receipts of 72,387.62 (its largest receipt) are probably the loan proceeds.
